description: Shortlist has only legacy purchase code: LegacyStoreHandler (clears old v2 store state) and an empty ProFeatureManager stub — no working purchase flow. Add the RevenueCat SDK, configure Purchases at launch, define the Pro Offering + entitlement in the RevenueCat dashboard, and wire ProFeatureManager to RevenueCat as the source of truth for Pro gating. NOTE: Shortlist is the legacy UIKit + Core Data app — do NOT rewrite the UI, just add the purchase layer.
title: Adopt RevenueCat for Pro entitlement
